title: Gluten-Free Aji Pasta
description: A flavorful and spicy gluten-free pasta dish made with aji peppers and crunchy elements.
instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of umami over medium heat.
Add the sliced aji peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the crushed acrunchy to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Combine the cooked pasta and the pan mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
